name: incline scapula push up
description: An incline push-up where you retract your shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
instructions: Place your hands on a flat bench or another raised surface, shoulder-width apart, and walk your feet back into a straight-body plank.
Keep your elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Let your chest sink toward the bench as your shoulder blades squeeze together.
Push the bench away to spread your shoulder blades apart.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
